adjudication.rationale:
The migration unconditionally does `execute(...)[0]['id']` for `embed_category`:

```rb
category_id = execute("SELECT c.id ... WHERE s.name = 'embed_category'")[0]['id'].to_i
```

If that query returns zero rows (e.g., no `site_settings` row exists for `embed_category`, which is likely when the setting was never overridden, or if the stored value doesn’t match any `categories.name`), then indexing `[0]` on an empty `PG::Result` will raise `IndexError`, aborting the migration before the fallback to `uncategorized_category_id` runs. This can block deploys.
